gen-press-start-2p-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clean and approachable, every small counter left unclogged. Press Start 2P puts a faint swell in each curve, like pulled taffy, while Biryani lays dowel stems and bent-dowel arcs beneath it.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-cossette-texte: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, thick strokes leading without dominating. Cossette Texte then reads like one single thread, and that smooth pull is what makes the pairing work.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-funnel-sans: Fun and a bit retro, Press Start 2P keeps hairlines that are present but never razor thin. Funnel Sans backs it with true monoline drawing, so the sans-serif text stays steady under the playful heading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, its words forming solid blocks rather than skylines. And Press Start 2P adds a faint thick-thin rhythm, like crayon on rough paper, over that plain sans.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-gidole: Gidole reads like neon glass, every stroke drawn as one tube. Press Start 2P has light contrast between verticals and curves, so Gidole's glowing, tube-like sameness becomes the pairing's standout.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Approachable, Hedvig Letters Sans leaves a wide gap where the c ends. But under Press Start 2P, its low contrast and near-capital small letters let reading run on easily.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads modern, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Its lowercase stands tall like stamped metal type, while Press Start 2P keeps thin parts clearly thinner yet never fragile.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along in constant line weight, with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle. While Press Start 2P gets attention with its pinned-apart letters, the sans-serif text just gets on with being read.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-huninn: Huninn outlines its counters in a single steady thickness, with lowercase bodies rising close to cap height and sturdy crossbars. Press Start 2P brings flat-brush contrast up top; Huninn settles below.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-karla: Modern and approachable, Karla has a gaping c opening and a middle band so tall it looks stocky. While Press Start 2P handles tempered thick-thin variation, the low-contrast sans handles the quiet, steady reading.
